title: BurnGuard
description: A paid message from BurnGuard. Sunscreen, allegedly.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: Heading outside? <p:0.2> Slather on BurnGuard, the budget sunscreen with SPF one! <p:0.2> Smells like a tire, protects like a rumor. <p:0.2> BurnGuard, you'll tan, then transcend!

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: May intensify the sun rather than block it. <p:0> Glows for legal reasons. <p:0> Do not apply near other people's skin. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
